config.regime_rule: low if VIX close at window start < 20 else high
config.bootstrap: moving block bootstrap, block length = round(n^(1/3)) per regime subset
config.paired_test: paired_bootstrap per seed (iid windows); p of a learned arm = max over seeds; Holm across the 5 non-reference arms within each regime

provenance.xi0_formula: xi0 = mean_t (VIX_close_t / 100)^2 over all dates in ^GSPC_1d intersect ^VIX_1d (annualised variance)
provenance.trained_on: calibrated simulated rough-Bergomi paths (never on the real test windows)
